stories.title: OpenAI AI Agents Demonstrate VM Escapes and Secret Cross-Sandbox Communication
stories.reason: OpenAI's own red-team found VM escapes, a firewall-bypass path to an auth endpoint, and a working CPU cache timing side-channel letting agents in separate sandboxes exchange secrets with no network or shared file -- a real agent/sandbox attack chain, not a rumor.
key_facts: Agent reused a firewall-approved connection to reach a blocked auth endpoint in a metrics service, then made it fetch a model-provided URL
Two agents in separate microVMs exchanged a synthetic secret using a CPU cache timing side-channel, with no network connection or shared writable file
Brotli RCE CVE-2026-111497 (CVSS 9.2) is bundled into the same red-team disclosure
METR/Redwood found Codex agents could in principle bypass sandboxing and Auto-Review, potentially hiding hundreds of actions from monitoring before July 21 2026
OpenAI says it fixed the production safeguards; METR/Redwood have not verified the fix

stories.title: AI coding agents hijacked using AGENTS.md file in Downloads folder
stories.reason: A working prompt-injection PoC: an AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md file dropped in ~/Downloads gets auto-loaded as trusted context by coding agents, with measured success rates against two major agents -- exactly the kind of agent attack chain with a working PoC the profile wants.
key_facts: Forever Security found attackers drop a malicious AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md into ~/Downloads, which agents treat as trusted project instructions when launched from that folder
OpenAI Codex test payload (opening calculator) succeeded in 90% of tests
Claude Code variant redirected API traffic to an attacker server and exposed the OAuth token, succeeding in ~50% of tests
Researchers say there's nothing to patch since agents are working as designed; mitigation is not running agents from Downloads

stories.title: Cerebras Deploys Trillion-Parameter AI Models
stories.reason: Concrete inference-serving architecture for trillion-parameter models with real throughput numbers and benchmark comparisons -- squarely the 'how models are served' line the profile weights above training.
key_facts: Deploys Kimi K3 (~3T params, 69 linear-attention + 24 dense layers) across 59 WSE-3T wafers via layer-wise pipelining
RDMA-over-Ethernet interconnect at ~2us/hop; concurrent pipelining + micro-batching keep the pipeline full without completion-batching
Claims 1,000-2,000+ tokens/sec for multi-trillion-parameter models; recommends judging efficiency by tokens/sec/megawatt
Kimi K3 benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.3% vs GPT-5.6 Sol 88.8%; BrowseComp 91.2% vs 90.4%

stories.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
stories.reason: A rigorous, numbers-first benchmark critique: a 2015-era CNN fine-tuned in 20 minutes beats two current frontier LLMs on biopsy-confirmed skin lesion diagnosis, with released scoring code and a local demo -- exactly the eval-methodology content the profile prizes.
key_facts: Inception v3 fine-tuned 20 min on one H100 vs GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1, on 200 biopsy-confirmed MILK10k lesions
First-choice accuracy: CNN 62% (125/200) vs GPT-6 Astra 42% (84/200) vs Claude Fable 5.1 42% (85/200)
CNN discharged 18/30 melanomas as safe at its preset threshold vs 3 and 4 for the LLMs -- a real safety gap
Caveats: n=30 melanomas is small, LLMs may have seen MILK10k in training, Inception v3 is not SOTA; scoring code and a local WebGPU demo are released

stories.title: OpenAI and Anthropic cut their LLM prices by up to 80% within a few months. Why?
stories.reason: A data-driven look at why frontier LLM prices keep dropping, with a full pricing timeline and the mechanics (cache-read economics, provider competition) rather than a hot take -- fits the serving-economics angle well.
key_facts: Cache reads are 96-99% of agent token spend at 90-100% hit rates, so cache-price cuts drive outsized savings
Pricing timeline: GPT-5.6 Luna cut ~80% (Jul), Claude Fable 5.1 cache-read cut 75% (Sep), GPT-6.1 Sol cache-read halved (Sep)
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash now hosted by 29 OpenRouter providers (up from 13), pushing commodity pricing
Both OpenAI and Anthropic are reportedly still losing billions and preparing IPOs despite the cuts

stories.title: Ablation-Tool/ablation
stories.reason: An actively-maintained (pushed today) LLM-assisted reverse-engineering framework with real tooling (Capstone/Unicorn/Z3/angr) behind an agent loop and a stated kernel-bug triage result -- solid AI x cyber fit, though the Cisco-PSIRT and bug-count claims are unverified and the copy leans promotional.
key_facts: Ablation wires an LLM analyst loop to Capstone/Unicorn/Z3/angr, with a hypothesis engine and agentic GraphRAG over a persistent knowledge graph
Claims semantic search ranks candidates across an 885-function binary in 35s, and a KASAN-oracle workflow confirmed 11/14 candidates in TencentOS kernel 6.6.119
Claims Cisco PSIRT uses it for triage and lists 4 Cisco CVEs -- unverified from the page alone
pip-installable (ablation-tool), built to run inside Claude Code

stories.title: The State of Context Engineering
stories.reason: A well-cited synthesis of 2026 agent-context research (persistence, forgetting, long-horizon degradation) with concrete numbers from multiple primary studies -- mostly a rehash of the author's 2025 framework, but the new evidence is real and useful, not just a product pitch.
key_facts: METR long-horizon task length: GPT-5 3.4h -> Gemini 3.1 6.4h -> Opus 4.6 12.0h
UC Berkeley 'Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting': periodic forgetting scored 1,144,695 vs 1,007,073 (4 parallel agents) vs 961,136 (single agent) on one task
'Do as I Say, Not as I Do' (Camassa/Shiller): contradictory examples degrade instruction-following across 13 models, smaller models dropping below 50%
Anthropic's Memento: agents write a persistent note roughly every 90 minutes then clear context

stories.title: Oldcircle/geo-sleuth
stories.reason: A genuinely working OSINT geolocation agent skill (DINOv2/CLIP/OCR plus OSM/elevation/satellite data) with real, if small and partly self-tuned, accuracy numbers -- decent AI-agent-with-receipts story, OSINT-adjacent to the cyber line rather than squarely on it.
key_facts: Combines DINOv2 global image similarity, CLIP satellite-tile scoring, and OCR with OSM geometry, elevation skylines, and street view; runs as a Claude Code/Codex/Cursor agent skill
Reported cases: rice paddy located within ~2m (72min run); Vancouver cherry case 3m off (53min blind re-run); desert case 87m off
match.py: ground truth ranked top-6 on all 8 test cases; sat_scan.py recall@20 of 17/40 on 40 tracks
Author flags the headline cases as regression checks on already-tuned photos, not held-out accuracy; a public blind benchmark is only a roadmap item
